buyCard.title: Kia nui ake ō painga ki Microsoft 365
buyCard.description: Kia 5 KKP te rokiroki ā-kapua me ngā taupānga pēnei i a Word e taea nei e koe te uru. Mō ngā rokiroki anō, mō te haumarutanga arā atu anō, mō ngā taupānga kakamatanga hoki, ohauru mai ki a Microsoft 365 Whaiaro, Whānau rānei.
buyCard.descriptionAI: Ngā putanga papamahi pēnei i ngā putanga papamahi pēnei Word me PowerPoint i hangaia ki te 6 TP rokiroki kapua hei tiritiri, haumarutanga arā atu anō, me ētahi atu mea i roto i te ohaurunga haumarutanga ihirangi kotahi.

description.basic: Kua kore koe e uru atu ki te rokiroki kapua 100 GB ā kō ake nei me ngā taupānga tukutuku pērā i a Word, Excel, me PowerPoint. Kia mau ki ēnei painga māu, me whakahōu tō tikanga utu.
description.personal: Kua kore koe e uru atu ki te rokiroki kapua 1 TB ā kō ake nei me ngā taupānga kakamatanga pērā i a Word, Excel, me PowerPoint. Kia mau ki ēnei painga, me whakahōu tō tikanga utu.
description.personalAI: Ākuanei ka ngaro atu i a koe te urunga ki ngā utauta auaha, kakamatanga hoki e whākahatia ana e te AI, ki ngā putanga papamahi o ngā taupānga pēnei i a Word me PowerPoint, ki te 1 TP hoki o te rokiroki ā-kapua haumaru kei roto kē tonu nā i tō ohaurunga.
description.family: Kua kore koe e uru atu ki te rokiroki kapua 1 TB ā kō ake nei me ngā taupānga kakamatanga pērā i a Word, Excel, me PowerPoint. Kia mau ki ēnei painga mā koutou ko ētahi atu i tiritahia rā e koe, me whakahōu tō tikanga utu.
description.familyAI: Ākuanei ka ngaro atu i a koe te urunga ki ngā utauta auaha, kakamatanga hoki e whākahatia ana e te AI, ā, ka kore e taea te hunga i tiria ai e koe te whakamahi rokiroki ā-kapua me ngā putanga papamahi o ngā taupānga pēnei i a Word me PowerPoint.

description.basic: Kāore i a koe te urunga ki te 100 GB o te rokiroki ā kapua me ngā taupānga tukutuku pēnei i te Word, Excel, me te PowerPoint ōrite.
description.personal: Kua kore koe e āhei ki te 1 TP o ngā rokiroki ā-kapua me ngā taupānga kakamatanga pērā i a Word, a Excel me PowerPoint.
description.personalAI: Ohauru mai anō hei wetemaukati i ngā utauta auaha, kakamatanga hoki e whākahatia ana e te AI, i ngā putanga papamahi o ngā taupānga pēnei i Word me PowerPoint, me te 1 TP o te rokiroki ā-kapua haumaru.
description.family: Kāore e āhei ana koutou ko ētahi atu i tiritahia rā e koe ki te 1 TP o ngā rokiroki ā-kapua me ngā taupānga kakamatanga pērā i a Word, a Excel me PowerPoint.
description.familyAI: Kua mutu tō urunga ki ngā wheako whākaha-ā-AI. Kāore e taea e koutou ko te hunga i tiria ai e koe te whakamahi rokiroki ā-kapua, i ngā putanga papamahi rānei o ngā taupānga pēnei i a Word me PowerPoint.

copilotSubscriptionCard.description: Kua wetemaukati koe i ngā āhuahira huhuatanga i Word, PowerPoint, me ētahi atu mea.
copilotSubscriptionCard.descriptionAI: Kua wetemaukatia nei e koe ngā whakautu tere ake me ngā whiwhinga maha atu mō ngā wheako ā-AI i roto i Word, i PowerPoint, i Designer me te maha atu.

buyCard.description: Whai wāhi atu ki ngā āhuahira kakamatanga tāuke i a koe e wetemaukati ana i a Copilot i rō Word, i PowerPoint, me te maha atu.
buyCard.descriptionAI: Kia tere ake ngā whakautu e whiwhi mai ai, kia maha atu hoki ngā whiwhinga mō ngā wheako ā-atamai hangahanga (AI) i roto i Word, i PowerPoint, i Designer me te maha atu.
buyCard.learnMore: He aha ngā mea i roto tonu i a Copilot Pro?

pastDueCard.description: Taro ake nei kua ngaro tō urunga ki te utauta auaha whakarei me ngā āhuahira kakamatanga tāuke kei roto kē tonu i Copilot Pro.
pastDueCard.descriptionAI: Ākuanei ka ngaro atu tō urunga ki ngā whakautu tere ake me ngā whiwhinga maha atu mō ngā wheako ā-AI puta noa i ngā taupānga Microsoft.

resubscribeCard.description: Ohauru anō hei wetemaukati āhuahira kakamatanga tāuke i Word, i PowerPoint, me te maha atu.
resubscribeCard.descriptionAI: Kua wetemaukatia nei e koe ngā whakautu tere ake me ngā whiwhinga maha atu mō ngā wheako ā-AI i roto i Word, i PowerPoint, i Designer me te maha atu.

description.pcGamePass: Ka taea te tākaro i ngā kēmu rorohiko rau maha. Whiwhi ki EA Play, ngā whakaritenga mema me ngā whakahekenga utu, me ētahi atu mea.
description.xboxGamePass: Ka taea te tākaro i ngā kēmu rau maha i te papatohu. Whiwhi ki EA Play, me ngā whakaritenga mema me ngā whakahekenga utu.
description.xboxGamePassStandard: E āhei atu ana koe ki te pūpāho papatohu tuihono, arā he putumōhio kēmu i tīpakona ai me ngā tukunga mā ngā mema me ngā hekenga utu.
description.xboxLiveGold: E āhei atu ana koe ki te pūpāho papatohu tuihono, arā he putumōhio kēmu i tīpakona ai me ngā tukunga mā ngā mema me ngā hekenga utu.
description.xboxGamePassUltimate: Ka taea te tākaro i ngā kēmu raumaha i runga i te papatohu, rorohiko, me te kapua. Whiwhi ki EA Play, te papatohu tuihono, me ētahi atu mea.

descriptionLotus.pcGamePass: Whakamātauria atu he tini o ngā taitara mīharo hou mō te rorohiko whaiaro. Uru atu ki a EA Play, ki ngā tukunga motuhake, ki ngā whiwhinga āpiti me ngā mea tuhene.
descriptionLotus.xboxLiveGold: Kia xx+ ngā taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki, ā, kia ngahau ahakoa kei hea. Uru atu ki ngā āhuahira papatohu tuihono. Kia riro mai ngā painga tuhene. Whiwhi paraihe tuhene.
descriptionLotus.xboxGamePassStandard: Tirotiro mā roto i ngā taitara e xxx+ mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki, ā, kia ngahau ahakoa kei hea. Kia riro mai ngā painga tuhene. Whiwhi paraihe motuhake.
descriptionLotus.xboxGamePassUltimate: He taitara mohou i te whakarewatanga. Kia xxx+ ngā taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki, ā, kia ngahau ahakoa kei hea. Uru ki ngā painga katoa. Kia tino maha kē atu ngā paraihe motuhake hei whiwhi.

pastDueCard.description: Ka mutu tō ohaurunga ā kō ake nei. Kia purei tonu, whakahōungia tō tikanga utu.

buyCard.title: Tūhuratia tō kēmu makau whai ake
buyCard.description: Kia tangata tuatahi ki te tākaro kēmu hou i te rā kotahi. Ka tukua e Xbox Game Pass te urunga ki ngā kēmu tino kounga rau maha i runga i te papatohu me te rorohiko.

buyCardLotus.title: Tūhura He Kōwhiringa Kēmu
buyCardLotus.description: He taitara mohou i te rā whakarewa. He tini ngā taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki, ā, kia ngahau ahakoa kei hea. Uru ki ngā painga. Kia horo ake te whiwhi paraihe. Tīpakohia tōu tāera hei whakamahi ki Ngā Kōwhiringa Kēmu.

productDescription.pcGamePass: Pureia ngā kēmu hōu i te rā tuatahi, pērā i a Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, i a Avowed anō hoki. Waihoki, kia tini ngā kēmu tino kounga hei purei i runga rorohiko whaiaro.
productDescription.xboxGamePassStandard: He tini ngā kēmu tino kounga hei tūhura, ka uru atu ki te pūpāho papatohu tuihono, ka whiwhi hoki i ngā utu pai me ngā hekenga utu mā ngā mema.
productDescription.xboxLiveGold: Purei tahi me ngā hoa mā te pūpāho papatohu tuihono, waihoki kia 25+ ngā kēmu tino kounga hei purei i runga papatohu, ka whiwhi i ngā utu pai mō ngā mema.
productDescription.xboxGamePassUltimate: Pureia ngā kēmu hōu i te rā tuatahi, pērā i a Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, i a Avowed anō hoki. Hei tāpiri, kia tini ngā kēmu tino kounga hei purei i te rorohiko whaiaro, i te papatohu, i te rorohiko whaiaro hoki.

productDescription.pcGamePass: Whai wāhi atu ki ngā taitara mohou mai i te whakarewatanga, pērā i a Halo: Infinite me Fable. Anō hoki, kia tini ngā kēmu mātāmua hei uru atu i te rorohiko whaiaro.
productDescription.xboxLiveGold: Kia xx+ ngā taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki me te purei ahakoa kei hea. Uru atu ki ngā āhuahira papatohu tuihono. Whiwhi mai i ngā painga tuhene. Whiwhi paraihe tuhene.
productDescription.xboxGamePassStandard: Tīpako mai i te xxx+ taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro. Mātakitaki me te purei ahakoa kei hea. Whiwhi mai i ngā painga tuhene. Whiwhi paraihe motuhake.
productDescription.xboxGamePassUltimate: He taitara mohou mai i te whakarewatanga. Kia xxx+ ngā taitara mō te papatohu, mō te rorohiko whaiaro hoki. Mātakitaki me te purei ahakoa kei hea. Whiwhi mai i ngā painga katoa. Kia tino maha kē atu ngā paraihe motuhake hei whiwhi.
